cards.explanation: The answer is False. Jesus says, "So practice and observe everything they tell you." (Matthew 23:3) The scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses' seat, and that's why their teaching still counts. What He warns about is copying how they live, friends, and that comes next.

The answer is that they do not practice what they preach. Jesus says, "But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach." (Matthew 23:3) The words are fine to follow, friends. The living is the part that doesn't match. That's like me teaching the recipe to everybody and never turning on my own oven.

The answer is that they will not lift a finger. Jesus says they "…are not willing to lift a finger to move them." (Matthew 23:4) They tie up heavy loads and lay them on men's shoulders. Those heavy loads get no help from them, friends.

The answer is so people will see them. Jesus says, "All their deeds are done for men to see." (Matthew 23:5) Their deeds are done to be seen, bakers. I've stamped cookies for an audience before, but my mustache didn't need the applause.

The answer is honor. Jesus says, "They love the places of honor at banquets…" (Matthew 23:6) Those are the best spots at the table, friends. I think they'd check the seating chart before they checked the guest list.

The answer is True! Jesus says they love "…the chief seats in the synagogues…" (Matthew 23:6) Those are the chief seats, the ones people notice, bakers. The verse also says they love the places of honor at banquets.

The answer is that they have one Teacher and are all brothers. Jesus says, "for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers." (Matthew 23:8) There are two reasons, friends, and both are right there in the verse. Verse 10 has a matching line: "…for you have one Instructor, the Christ." (Matthew 23:10)

The answer is father. Jesus says, "And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven." (Matthew 23:9) The one Father is in heaven, bakers. I'd never argue with that, since my own cookie cutter kids called me Papa.
The answer is the Christ. Jesus says, "…for you have one Instructor, the Christ." (Matthew 23:10) The Christ is the Messiah (John 1:41). Jesus names Him as the one Instructor, friends.

The answer is the one who is your servant! Jesus says, "The greatest among you shall be your servant." (Matthew 23:11) The great one is the one who serves, bakers. That flips the banquet seating chart right over.

The answer is False. Jesus says, "For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted." (Matthew 23:12) Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, friends. Whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
